row.evidence: LinkedIn Help: "SCIM is available for Sales Navigator Advanced and Advanced Plus users."
row.notes: New row. LinkedIn help says SCIM and SAML SSO are both available on Sales Navigator Advanced and Advanced Plus; Advanced is the cheapest multi-seat plan (Core is aimed at individual sellers), so SCIM carries no tax. Prices from the compare-plans FAQ: Core US$1,079.88/yr per license ($89.99/mo) or $119.99 monthly; Advanced US$1,799.88/yr ($149.99/mo) or $159.99 monthly; Advanced Plus is quote-only. SCIM supports Okta, OneLogin and Microsoft Entra ID only (no generic endpoint documented; Entra uses tenant URL https://developer.linkedin.com). Token from Admin Center > Settings > Global Settings > SCIM, valid two years; SSO is not required. SCIM assigns and revokes licenses (frees seats) and pushes groups one way; users still activate their own license and roles stay in Admin Center. No public user-management API: Sales Navigator APIs require SNAP partner approval.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Individual sellers; SSO and SCIM are documented only for Advanced and Advanced Plus.

auth.token_source: LinkedIn Admin Center > Settings > Global Settings > SCIM > + Add new SCIM configuration > Generate token (optionally with auto-assign licenses and a license type)

operations.notes: Okta app lists Create users, Update user attributes, Deactivate users, Group push, Import users. PUT vs PATCH not documented; update is true.

deprovision.notes: Deprovisioning revokes the Sales Navigator license / access; the docs do not say whether the enterprise profile is deleted.

custom.how: Mapping is "limited to these fields for now".

roles.how: Admin/non-admin roles stay in LinkedIn Admin Center; SCIM assigns the license type chosen on the SCIM configuration (a second configuration/token handles TeamLink Extend licenses).

limitations.text: Only Okta, OneLogin and Microsoft Entra ID are supported; no generic SCIM endpoint is documented.
One-way sync only; Sales Navigator groups cannot be written back, and SCIM-managed users/groups are view-only in Admin Center.
Users must still activate their own license after SCIM assigns it.
When eligible users exceed available licenses, licenses go first-come to the first N users and the IdP gets an error.
Okta "Push Now" re-sync is not supported; group names must be unique on first push.
Admin Center reflects IdP changes on an hourly sync.
Licenses provisioned manually must also be removed manually.

user_api.notes: Sales Navigator API permissions are limited to approved SNAP partners and cover CRM/analytics/display use cases; no customer user-management API is documented.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push (read from page markup); SAML is not checked on this app.

entra.notes: Entra SSO tutorial also says the app supports Just In Time user provisioning.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin's connector page was not loaded; LinkedIn's help lists OneLogin as a supported SCIM IdP.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud article covers SAML SSO only.

fallbacks.notes: Microsoft's Entra SSO tutorial claims JIT provisioning; LinkedIn's own help does not describe JIT, so jit stays null. LinkedIn supports SAML 2.0 only (no OIDC).
